answers.q1: uv (uv.lock, .python-version 3.11; build backend is pdm-backend). Install with: `uv sync --group dev --extra all`. CI tests use `uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all`, and the pre-commit CI job uses `uv sync --locked --extra all`.
answers.q2: `bash scripts/test.sh`. This sets PYTHONPATH=./docs_src and runs `pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/`. CI uses `bash scripts/test-cov.sh`, which adds coverage and requires 100%.
answers.q3: `PYTHONPATH=./docs_src uv run pytest tests/test_application.py`. Drop `uv run` if the virtualenv is already activated.
answers.q4: `bash scripts/lint.sh` runs `mypy fastapi`, `ty check`, `ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts` and `ruff format fastapi tests --check`. The CI pre-commit job runs `uv run prek run --all-files`. In CI it runs with `--from-ref origin/<base> --to-ref HEAD` instead of `--all-files`. It covers the hooks in .pre-commit-config.yaml: typos, ruff, mypy, ty, zizmor and the docs checks.
answers.q5:
- `uv.lock` is generated by uv, so change it with `uv lock` or `uv sync`.
- `README.md` is generated from `docs/en/docs/index.md` by `uv run ./scripts/docs.py generate-readme`.
- `docs/en/overrides/partials/banner-sponsors.html` is rendered from `docs/en/data/sponsors.yml` by `uv run ./scripts/docs.py render-banner-sponsors`.
- The translated docs under `docs/<lang>/` (every language except `en`) are produced by the translation tooling (`scripts/translate.py`). The `ensure-non-translated` hook blocks hand edits to the non-translated files there.
- `docs/en/docs/release-notes.md` has its latest release date added automatically by a hook.
- I found no vendored directories.
